findings.finding: The common readiness predicates require current complete IADM and current issuer/W state for both modes. Initial IADM is the object being created; requiring its already authenticated original closes the bootstrap cycle despite task_rules saying cycle avoidance unchanged.
findings.required_fix: Define separate closed IADM and IRCS readiness predicates. IADM must join genuine independently admitted Site/native provision control and the accepted acyclic initial checkpoint/state inputs without requiring the not-yet-issued IADM or current issuer status. IRCS must require the already admitted complete IADM/current state. Provide separate negative/positive spec cases; no substitute authority.

findings.finding: These new security bindings have lengths but no exact canonical preimages/hash algorithms or checked equality rules. A field called SHA does not define whether it covers unsigned body, full response, envelope or context; the reference model compares pre body bytes rather than a 32-byte envelope reference.
findings.required_fix: Freeze exact byte-level digest definitions and contextual equality checks for readiness/task references. Explicitly bind immutable ceremony/mode/ordinal and exact task body. Define preEnvelopeReference against the exact retained PRE envelope, using the existing IRCS domain/envelope-NUL reference when intended, and test wrong envelope with identical body and changed task context. Preserve adopted signed body arrays/domains.

findings.finding: The actual existingRegistration() calls signer.publicKey(), which creates another LAContext and performs private-key lookup with interaction permitted. Calling it during pre-Face DATA acquisition does not establish a single evaluated ceremony and can trigger a separate key-access prompt. The current source recipe does not select how this is avoided.
findings.required_fix: Specify noninteractive existence/enrollment DATA before FaceID, then load/compare the existing public key through publicKey(using: sameFreshCeremony) and sign through that same context; never create/register. Explicitly deny extra authentication/background/context loss and require native one-prompt evidence. An API name existingRegistration is not proof of no additional authentication.
